name: Lunar Eclipse needs four Lunar Phase stacks, and spends four when consumed, even with Bright Moon (#4273)
contract: Lunar Phase 802985 says "At 4 stacks you can activate Lunar Eclipse"; Lunar Eclipse 800386 carries CasterAuraSpell 704519 (Spell.dbc field 24, "4 Stacks of Lunar Phase"), a marker aura only C++ applies. Bright Moon 801226 effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER on SPELLMOD_MAX_AURA_STACKS with base points 3, so it raises only the stack cap (SpellInfo::CalcMaxAuraStacks) from 4 to 8, not the activation threshold. On origin/main AscensionStarcaller::GainPhase applied 704519 only when the count equals MaxPhase (8), Refresh stripped it below MaxPhase, starcaller_spells::OnSpellCheckCast compared the count with MaxPhase, and OnSpellBeforeEffects removed 802985 entirely, so with Bright Moon the Eclipse needs 8 stacks and spends all of them. Fixed: threshold constant 4, activation spends exactly four stacks. Fixture 'four' knows Bright Moon and holds exactly 4 stacks plus the marker: the cast must succeed (fails before the fix with SPELL_FAILED_CASTER_AURASTATE) and leave no Lunar Phase. Fixture 'eight' holds 8 stacks: after the cast 4 must remain (the passive gain of one stack per several seconds may add one before the assert, hence the 4..5 window) and the marker must survive since 4 remain. Set_aura writes the stacks directly, the cast is the native spell 800386 with its native cast check plus the module hook.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Activate Lunar Eclipse at exactly four stacks with Bright Moon
Activation keeps the four stacks until the Eclipse is consumed
Activate Lunar Eclipse at eight stacks
Learn Moonwell Splash, a Lunar spell that consumes the Eclipse
Wound the fixture so Moonwell Splash has something to heal
DISCRIMINATING: consuming the Eclipse spent exactly four of the eight stacks (one passive gain may add a fifth)
